Hi Lena — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. I received the bank letter and W-9 and looped in Jordan (PayOps) and Marissa (Vendor Onboarding) so we can complete the activation steps.

A couple of short asks so we can match invoices to POs automatically:
- We require the Redwood PO number to appear in the remittance reference field; example format we look for is PO-#### (we'll share an exact mapping).
- For automated reconciliation we expect a CSV with these columns: invoice_number, invoice_date, amount, po_number, remit_email (if different). If Acme has an existing remit CSV template, please attach — otherwise a 1-row sample with headers is perfect.
- We do a micro-deposit verification for ACH by default. Please confirm you'll send two micro-deposits (amounts < $1) tomorrow and the exact times (approx) so Jordan can watch for them. If you'd rather do a $1 wire test, state that and we'll coordinate timing.

Marissa — can you confirm whether we need DUNS or any additional supplier code from Acme before activation?

Lena — when you reply please include any payment terms link (DocuSign or portal) and the remit CSV if available.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments referenced: bank_letter_acmeinc.pdf, W9_AcmeInc.pdf
